verdict.rationale: Obsidian itself has no first-party natural-language command interface; the only evidence of AI-driven interaction is a community plugin (Text-Generator) used to pull linked notes into an LLM prompt, and even that is described as lacking solid RAG support. Missing for 10: official docs on natural-language command execution, first-party AI command palette, evidence of broad NL command coverage beyond a single third-party plugin.
